# Original sounddevice test input

This is the unchanged PyPI sounddevice 0.5.5 pure Python wheel, retained as a small byte-pinned fixture for the Android loader compatibility patch. Tests inspect its original source and exercise the loader-selection block with controlled library calls; they do not import the wheel or claim native audio results.

Origin: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/1e/0a/478e441fd049002cf308520c0d62dd8333e7c6cc8d997f0dda07b9fbcc46/sounddevice-0.5.5-py3-none-any.whl

SHA-256: 30ff99f6c107f49d25ad16a45cacd8d91c25a1bcdd3e81a206b921a3a6405b1f

The original MIT license is included both beside the fixture and inside the wheel.
